## Plot K13 IBD-only windows

This chunk identifies the highest 15% of hmmIBD windows within each K13 group, annotates their genes, and plots them without requiring evidence from Tajima's D, iHS, or XP-EHH.

```{r plot-k13-ibd-only-windows, eval=TRUE}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-show: hold
################################################################################
# CHUNK 13: IBD-ONLY WINDOW ANNOTATION AND KARYOGRAM
# Purpose:
#   Annotates and plots high-IBD windows on their own. Unlike CHUNK 11/12, a
#   window is kept here on IBD evidence alone, with no overlap requirement
#   against Tajima's D, iHS, or XP-EHH.
# Inputs:
#   - output_gambella_arbaminch/hmmibd_result/group/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv
# Outputs:
#   - output_gambella_arbaminch/comp_selection_signals_window/gambella_arbaminch_ibd_only_windows.tsv
#   - output_gambella_arbaminch/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_ibd_only_<group>.pdf
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - High IBD windows: fraction >= the 85th percentile within each group.
#   - Gene labels come from the hmmIBD annotation columns only: gene_name when
#     available, otherwise gene_id.
################################################################################
# Requires CHUNK 12 to have been run: reuses make_karyogram(), chr_lengths, chr_polys, cen_pts.

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IBD_FILE       <- "output_k13_hrp/k13_result/hmmibd_result/k13/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv"
IBD_OUT_TSV    <- "output_k13_hrp/k13_result/comp_selection_signals_window/k13_ibd_only_windows.tsv"
IBD_OUT_PREFIX <- "output_k13_hrp/k13_result/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_ibd_only"
IBD_QUANTILE   <- 0.85

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "WT_622" = "WT_622",
  "Mutant_622"  = "Mutant_622"
)
# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD AND FILTER HIGH-IBD WINDOWS
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading IBD data:", IBD_FILE, "\n")
ibd_raw <- read.delim(IBD_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("  Total IBD windows:", nrow(ibd_raw), "\n")

ibd_only <- ibd_raw %>%
  filter(!chr %in% c("Pf_M76611", "Pf3D7_API_v3"), !is.na(fraction)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(p_high = quantile(fraction, IBD_QUANTILE, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(fraction >= p_high) %>%
  transmute(
    Chr          = suppressWarnings(as.integer(gsub("Pf3D7_0|Pf3D7_|_v3", "", chr))),
    win_start    = as.numeric(start),
    win_end      = as.numeric(end),
    group        = category,
    IBD_fraction = fraction,
    IBD_gene_id  = gene_id,
    IBD_genes    = gene_name,
    IBD_products = gene_product
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chr), !is.na(win_start), !is.na(win_end))

cat("  High IBD windows (>= q", IBD_QUANTILE, " per group):", nrow(ibd_only), "\n", sep = "")
print(table(ibd_only$group))

dir.create(dirname(IBD_OUT_TSV), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fwrite(ibd_only, IBD_OUT_TSV, sep = "\t")
cat("Saved:", IBD_OUT_TSV, "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. GENE LABELS FROM IBD ANNOTATION ONLY
# ==============================================================================

# hmmIBD stores plain gene names, so the parenthesised parser used for EHH/TD is not applied here.
IBD_NA_LABELS <- c("N/A", "NA", "")

ibd_gene_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(IBD_genes), !IBD_genes %in% IBD_NA_LABELS) %>%
    group_by(Chr, win_start, win_end) %>%
    summarise(label = paste(unique(IBD_genes), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pos_mid = (win_start + win_end) / 2) %>%
    group_by(Chr, pos_mid) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. PER-GROUP IBD-ONLY KARYOGRAMS
# ==============================================================================

windows_ibd <- ibd_only %>%
  mutate(n_datasets = 1L) %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

groups_ibd <- sort(unique(windows_ibd$group))
message("Generating IBD-only figures for: ", paste(groups_ibd, collapse = ", "))

for (grp in groups_ibd) {
  win_g <- windows_ibd %>% filter(group == grp)
  glabs <- ibd_gene_labels(ibd_only %>% filter(group == grp))

  grp_label <- ifelse(grp %in% names(GROUP_LABELS), GROUP_LABELS[[grp]], grp)

  p_g <- make_karyogram(
    win_g,
    start_col    = "win_start",
    end_col      = "win_end",
    gene_labs    = glabs,
    title_str    = paste0("High-IBD Windows - ", grp_label),
    subtitle_str = paste0("hmmIBD only | fraction >= q", IBD_QUANTILE, " within group")
  )

  fname <- paste0(IBD_OUT_PREFIX, "_", grp)
  ggsave(paste0(fname, ".pdf"), plot = p_g, width = 20, height = 10, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", fname, ".pdf")
  print(p_g)
}

cat("Done.\n")
```

## Local IBD across the K13-HRP3 chromosome 13 interval

This is the priority analysis for asking whether K13 R622I and HRP3 deletion sit on the same local chromosome 13 background. The plot below reuses the existing 10 kb hmmIBD window outputs and focuses only on the interval spanning K13 and HRP3. K13 R622I is marked as a single SNP position, while HRP3/HRPIII is shown as a region.

```{r chr13-local-ibd-k13-hrp-interval}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IBD_INTERVAL_DIR <- "output_k13_hrp/chr13_local_ibd"
dir.create(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

K13_POS <- 1725133
HRP3_START <- 2835750
HRP3_END <- 2846640
HRP3_MID <- (HRP3_START + HRP3_END) / 2
INTERVAL_START <- 1600000
INTERVAL_END <- 2900000

K13_IBD_FILE <- "output_k13_hrp/k13_result/hmmibd_result/k13/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv"
HRP_IBD_FILE <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/hmmibd_result/hrp_status/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv"

prepare_ibd_track <- function(file, comparison_label) {
  read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Chr = suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_replace_all(chr, "Pf3D7_|Pf3D7_0|_v3", ""))),
      start = as.numeric(start),
      end = as.numeric(end),
      fraction = as.numeric(fraction),
      category = as.character(category),
      comparison = comparison_label
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Chr == 13,
      end >= INTERVAL_START,
      start <= INTERVAL_END
    ) %>%
    group_by(comparison, category, Chr, start, end) %>%
    summarise(
      fraction = first(fraction),
      gene_name = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(gene_name))), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      window_mid = (start + end) / 2,
      region_label = case_when(
        start <= K13_POS & end >= K13_POS ~ "K13_R622I_window",
        end >= HRP3_START & start <= HRP3_END ~ "HRP3_region_overlap",
        TRUE ~ "K13_HRP3_interval"
      )
    )
}

local_ibd <- bind_rows(
  prepare_ibd_track(K13_IBD_FILE, "K13 genotype groups"),
  prepare_ibd_track(HRP_IBD_FILE, "HRP deletion groups")
) %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c("Mutant_622", "WT_622", "hrp3_only_deleted", "hrp2_hrp3_deleted", "wild")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(comparison, category, start)

write_tsv(local_ibd, file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_k13_hrp_local_ibd_windows.tsv"))

local_ibd_summary <- local_ibd %>%
  filter(region_label %in% c("K13_R622I_window", "HRP3_region_overlap")) %>%
  group_by(comparison, category, region_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_windows = n(),
    mean_fraction = mean(fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_fraction = max(fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_tsv(local_ibd_summary, file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_k13_hrp_local_ibd_summary.tsv"))

p_local_ibd <- ggplot(local_ibd, aes(x = window_mid, y = fraction, color = category, group = category)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = HRP3_START, xmax = HRP3_END, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = K13_POS, linetype = "dashed", color = "#D62728", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE) +
  annotate("text", x = K13_POS, y = Inf, label = "K13 R622I", angle = 90,
           vjust = 1.2, hjust = 1.05, size = 3, color = "#D62728") +
  annotate("text", x = HRP3_MID, y = Inf, label = "HRP3/HRPIII region",
           vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, color = "#4E79A7") +
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(INTERVAL_START, INTERVAL_END),
    labels = function(x) paste0(round(x / 1e6, 2), " Mb")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Chromosome 13 position",
    y = "Mean pairwise IBD fraction per 10 kb window",
    color = "Group",
    title = "Local IBD across the K13-HRP3 chromosome 13 interval",
    subtitle = "K13 R622I is shown as a dashed line; HRP3/HRPIII is shown as a regional band"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_k13_hrp_local_ibd_track.png"), p_local_ibd,
       width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p_local_ibd)

local_ibd_summary
```

## Pairwise local chr13 sharing heatmap and network

The group-level track above summarizes hmmIBD windows. This secondary analysis asks which individual samples share the same local chr13 genotype background. The pairwise score is mean IBS-style similarity across non-missing chr13 SNP dosages, where identical dosages score 1 and a two-allele dosage difference scores 0. This is a local genotype-sharing proxy, not a replacement for a formal chromosome-restricted hmmIBD run.

```{r chr13-pairwise-local-sharing}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IBD_INTERVAL_DIR <- "output_k13_hrp/chr13_local_ibd"
GT_TSV <- "output_k13_hrp/chr13_ld/chr13_all_positions_genotypes.tsv"
METADATA_FILE <- "output_k13_hrp/metadata/k13_hrp_hmmibd_metadata.tsv"
MIN_SHARED_SNPS <- 100
LOCAL_IBS_CUTOFFS <- c(0.85, 0.90, 0.95)
INTERVAL_START <- 1600000
INTERVAL_END <- 2900000

sample_names <- read_lines("output_k13_hrp/chr13_ld/chr13_ld_sample_order.txt")
gt_raw <- read_tsv(
  GT_TSV,
  col_names = c("chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "bcsq", sample_names),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character(), pos = col_double()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(pos >= INTERVAL_START, pos <= INTERVAL_END)

metadata_local <- read_tsv(METADATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    hrp3_deleted = hrp_deletion_call %in% c("hrp2+/hrp3-", "hrp2-/hrp3-"),
    group_label = case_when(
      k13_mutation == "Mutant_622" ~ "K13_R622I",
      hrp3_deleted ~ "HRP3_deleted",
      TRUE ~ "WT_or_HRP3_intact"
    )
  )

samples_in_both <- intersect(sample_names, metadata_local$Sample)

gt_to_dosage <- function(gt) {
  if (is.na(gt) || gt %in% c(".", "./.", ".|.")) return(NA_real_)
  alleles <- unlist(strsplit(gsub("|", "/", gt, fixed = TRUE), "/", fixed = TRUE))
  if (any(alleles == ".")) return(NA_real_)
  sum(as.numeric(alleles), na.rm = TRUE)
}

dosage <- gt_raw %>%
  select(all_of(samples_in_both)) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  apply(c(1, 2), gt_to_dosage)

pairwise_local_ibs <- function(sample_a, sample_b) {
  genotype_a <- dosage[, sample_a]
  genotype_b <- dosage[, sample_b]
  keep <- !is.na(genotype_a) & !is.na(genotype_b)
  n_shared <- sum(keep)
  if (n_shared < MIN_SHARED_SNPS) {
    return(c(shared_snps = n_shared, local_ibs = NA_real_))
  }
  similarity <- 1 - abs(genotype_a[keep] - genotype_b[keep]) / 2
  c(shared_snps = n_shared, local_ibs = mean(similarity))
}

pair_results <- list()
result_index <- 1L
for (i in seq_len(length(samples_in_both) - 1L)) {
  for (j in (i + 1L):length(samples_in_both)) {
    scores <- pairwise_local_ibs(i, j)
    pair_results[[result_index]] <- tibble(
      sample1 = samples_in_both[i],
      sample2 = samples_in_both[j],
      shared_snps = as.integer(scores[["shared_snps"]]),
      local_ibs = as.numeric(scores[["local_ibs"]])
    )
    result_index <- result_index + 1L
  }
}

pairwise_scores <- bind_rows(pair_results) %>%
  left_join(metadata_local %>% select(Sample, k13_mutation, hrp_deletion_call, Site),
            by = c("sample1" = "Sample")) %>%
  rename(k13_1 = k13_mutation, hrp_1 = hrp_deletion_call, site_1 = Site) %>%
  left_join(metadata_local %>% select(Sample, k13_mutation, hrp_deletion_call, Site),
            by = c("sample2" = "Sample")) %>%
  rename(k13_2 = k13_mutation, hrp_2 = hrp_deletion_call, site_2 = Site)

write_tsv(pairwise_scores, file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_pairwise_local_ibs.tsv"))

score_matrix <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(samples_in_both),
  ncol = length(samples_in_both),
  dimnames = list(samples_in_both, samples_in_both)
)
diag(score_matrix) <- 1
for (row in seq_len(nrow(pairwise_scores))) {
  sample_a <- pairwise_scores$sample1[row]
  sample_b <- pairwise_scores$sample2[row]
  score_matrix[sample_a, sample_b] <- pairwise_scores$local_ibs[row]
  score_matrix[sample_b, sample_a] <- pairwise_scores$local_ibs[row]
}

write.table(
  score_matrix,
  file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_pairwise_local_ibs_matrix.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  col.names = NA
)

sample_order <- metadata_local %>%
  filter(Sample %in% samples_in_both) %>%
  arrange(k13_mutation != "Mutant_622", hrp3_deleted, Site, Sample) %>%
  pull(Sample)

heatmap_long <- as.data.frame(score_matrix[sample_order, sample_order]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample1, names_to = "sample2", values_to = "local_ibs")

heatmap_metadata <- metadata_local %>% select(Sample, k13_mutation, hrp3_deleted, Site)
heatmap_long <- heatmap_long %>%
  left_join(heatmap_metadata, by = c("sample1" = "Sample")) %>%
  rename(k13_1 = k13_mutation, hrp3_1 = hrp3_deleted, site_1 = Site) %>%
  left_join(heatmap_metadata, by = c("sample2" = "Sample")) %>%
  rename(k13_2 = k13_mutation, hrp3_2 = hrp3_deleted, site_2 = Site)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = sample1, y = sample2, fill = local_ibs)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90", name = "Local\nIBS") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "Pairwise local chr13 genotype sharing",
    subtitle = "K13-HRP3 interval; higher values indicate more similar local genotype dosages"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_pairwise_local_ibs_heatmap.png"),
       p_heatmap, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
print(p_heatmap)

local_network_scores <- pairwise_scores %>%
  transmute(sample1, sample2, fract_sites_IBD = local_ibs)

plot_hmmibd_cutoff_panel(
  ibd = local_network_scores,
  metadata = metadata_local,
  ibd_cutoffs = LOCAL_IBS_CUTOFFS,
  sample_id_col = "Sample",
  ibd_col = "fract_sites_IBD",
  color_by = "k13_mutation",
  shape_by = "hrp_deletion_call",
  show_isolates = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  shape_values = c("hrp2+/hrp3+" = 21, "hrp2+/hrp3-" = 22,
                   "hrp2-/hrp3+" = 23, "hrp2-/hrp3-" = 24)
)

save_hmmibd_cutoff_panel(
  file = file.path(IBD_INTERVAL_DIR, "chr13_pairwise_local_ibs_network_by_cutoff.png"),
  width = 1800,
  height = 1200,
  res = 150,
  ibd = local_network_scores,
  metadata = metadata_local,
  ibd_cutoffs = LOCAL_IBS_CUTOFFS,
  sample_id_col = "Sample",
  ibd_col = "fract_sites_IBD",
  color_by = "k13_mutation",
  shape_by = "hrp_deletion_call",
  show_isolates = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  shape_values = c("hrp2+/hrp3+" = 21, "hrp2+/hrp3-" = 22,
                   "hrp2-/hrp3+" = 23, "hrp2-/hrp3-" = 24)
)

cat("Samples:", length(samples_in_both), "\n")
cat("Local IBS cutoffs:", paste(LOCAL_IBS_CUTOFFS, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Genome-wide LD between K13 R622I and all SNP loci

HRP3 deletion is a structural/deletion phenotype, so it should not be treated as an ordinary SNP in this LD scan. The first step below extracts genotypes genome-wide to estimate pairwise allele correlation ($r^2$) between R622I and all filtered SNP positions across the 14 chromosomes.

```{bash extract-chr13-k13-hrp-ld-genotypes, eval=FALSE}
PROJECT_DIR="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1

LD_DIR="output_k13_hrp/chr13_ld"
mkdir -p "$LD_DIR"

# Primary LD input: sample-subset, MAF-filtered VCF before hypervariable/Tajima-window removal.
LD_VCF="output_k13_hrp/k13_result/data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz"

# Optional sensitivity input: uncomment to repeat after hypervariable + top-Tajima window removal.
# LD_VCF="output_k13_hrp/k13_result/data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.vcf.gz"

METADATA="output_k13_hrp/metadata/k13_hrp_hmmibd_metadata.tsv"

bcftools query -l "$LD_VCF" > "$LD_DIR/chr13_ld_sample_order.txt"
bcftools query \
  -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT\t%INFO/BCSQ[\t%GT]\n' \
  "$LD_VCF" > "$LD_DIR/genome_wide_all_positions_genotypes.tsv"
```

```{r chr13-r622i-ld-scan, eval=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

LD_DIR <- "output_k13_hrp/chr13_ld"
GT_TSV <- file.path(LD_DIR, "genome_wide_all_positions_genotypes.tsv")
SAMPLE_ORDER <- file.path(LD_DIR, "chr13_ld_sample_order.txt")
METADATA_FILE <- "output_k13_hrp/metadata/k13_hrp_hmmibd_metadata.tsv"

K13_POS <- 1725133
MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES <- 10
PLOT_MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES <- 20
PLOT_MIN_MAF <- 0.05
FWS_MIN <- 0.95 # Set to 0.95 for a high-Fws sensitivity scan.

sample_names <- read_lines(SAMPLE_ORDER)
gt_raw <- read_tsv(
  GT_TSV,
  col_names = c("chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "bcsq", sample_names),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character(), pos = col_double()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

metadata_ld <- read_tsv(METADATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    hrp3_deleted = hrp_deletion_call %in% c("hrp2+/hrp3-", "hrp2-/hrp3-"),
    k13_mutation = factor(k13_mutation, levels = c("WT_622", "Mutant_622"))
  )

if (!is.na(FWS_MIN)) {
  metadata_ld <- metadata_ld %>% filter(!is.na(fws), fws >= FWS_MIN)
}

samples_in_both <- intersect(sample_names, metadata_ld$Sample)

gt_to_dosage <- function(gt) {
  if (is.na(gt) || gt %in% c(".", "./.", ".|.")) return(NA_real_)
  alleles <- unlist(strsplit(gsub("|", "/", gt, fixed = TRUE), "/", fixed = TRUE))
  if (any(alleles == ".")) return(NA_real_)
  sum(as.numeric(alleles), na.rm = TRUE)
}

dosage <- gt_raw %>%
  select(all_of(samples_in_both)) %>%
  as.matrix()

dosage <- apply(dosage, c(1, 2), gt_to_dosage)

if (!any(gt_raw$pos == K13_POS)) {
  nearest <- gt_raw %>%
    mutate(distance_to_k13 = abs(pos - K13_POS)) %>%
    arrange(distance_to_k13) %>%
    slice(1:5) %>%
    select(chrom, pos, ref, alt, bcsq, distance_to_k13)
  print(nearest)
  stop("R622I position was not found in the LD genotype table. Check K13_POS or use a less filtered VCF.")
}

k13_index <- which(gt_raw$pos == K13_POS)[1]
k13_dosage <- dosage[k13_index, ]

calc_r2 <- function(test_dosage, focal_dosage) {
  keep <- !is.na(test_dosage) & !is.na(focal_dosage)
  n_complete <- sum(keep)
  if (n_complete < MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES) return(c(n_complete = n_complete, r = NA_real_, r2 = NA_real_))
  if (sd(test_dosage[keep]) == 0 || sd(focal_dosage[keep]) == 0) {
    return(c(n_complete = n_complete, r = NA_real_, r2 = NA_real_))
  }
  r <- cor(test_dosage[keep], focal_dosage[keep])
  c(n_complete = n_complete, r = r, r2 = r^2)
}

ld_stats <- t(apply(dosage, 1, calc_r2, focal_dosage = k13_dosage)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

allele_freq <- rowMeans(dosage, na.rm = TRUE) / 2

ld_table <- gt_raw %>%
  select(chrom, pos, ref, alt, bcsq) %>%
  bind_cols(ld_stats) %>%
  mutate(
    n_complete = as.integer(n_complete),
    allele_freq = allele_freq,
    maf = pmin(allele_freq, 1 - allele_freq),
    Gene_ID = vapply(strsplit(replace_na(bcsq, ""), "\\|"), function(x) {
      if (length(x) >= 3) x[[3]] else NA_character_
    }, character(1)),
    gene_name = vapply(strsplit(replace_na(bcsq, ""), "\\|"), function(x) {
      if (length(x) >= 2) x[[2]] else NA_character_
    }, character(1))
  ) %>%
  arrange(chrom, pos)

write_tsv(ld_table, file.path(LD_DIR, "genome_wide_R622I_snp_ld.tsv"))

top_ld <- ld_table %>%
  filter(!(chrom == "Pf3D7_13_v3" & pos == K13_POS), !is.na(r2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(r2)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

write_tsv(top_ld, file.path(LD_DIR, "genome_wide_R622I_top_ld_snps.tsv"))

ld_plot_table <- ld_table %>%
  filter(
    n_complete >= PLOT_MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES,
    maf >= PLOT_MIN_MAF,
    !is.na(r2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    chrom_num = suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_replace_all(chrom, "Pf3D7_|Pf3D7_0|_v3", "")))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom_num))

write_tsv(ld_plot_table, file.path(LD_DIR, "genome_wide_R622I_snp_ld_plot_filtered.tsv"))

chr_lengths_df <- data.frame(
  chrom_num = 1:14,
  length = c(643292, 947102, 1067971, 1200490, 1343557, 1418242, 1445207,
             1472805, 1541735, 1687656, 2038340, 2271494, 2925236, 3291936)
) %>% arrange(chrom_num) %>%
  mutate(offset = cumsum(lag(length, default = 0)) + (chrom_num - 1) * 2e5)

ld_plot_table <- ld_plot_table %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths_df %>% select(chrom_num, offset), by = "chrom_num") %>%
  mutate(pos_cum = pos + offset)

chr_midpoints <- chr_lengths_df %>%
  mutate(mid = offset + length / 2)

p_ld_gw <- ggplot(ld_plot_table, aes(x = pos_cum, y = r2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = maf), alpha = 0.8, size = 1.3, stroke = 0) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "MAF") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chr_midpoints$mid, labels = chr_midpoints$chrom_num) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = expression(r^2~"with K13 R622I"),
    title = "Genome-wide LD with K13 R622I (Pf3D7_13_v3:1725133)",
    subtitle = paste0("Plot filter: MAF >= ", PLOT_MIN_MAF,
                      "; complete genotypes >= ", PLOT_MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(LD_DIR, "genome_wide_R622I_ld.png"), p_ld_gw, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300)
print(p_ld_gw)

top_ld
```




## Hrp2/3 selection signals 

## comp_selection_signals_snps for the hrp2 deletion status

This chunk merges significant HRP deletion iHS and XP-EHH SNPs by genomic coordinate and focal group. It creates a table showing whether each SNP is supported by one or both selection methods.

```{r integrate-hrp-snp-signals, eval=FALSE}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 9: INTEGRATE SNP-LEVEL iHS AND XP-EHH SIGNALS
# Purpose:
#   Combines significant SNPs from iHS and XP-EHH into one SNP-level table. SNPs
#   are matched by chromosome and position, and XP-EHH rows are retained with iHS
#   rows only when the iHS group matches the first XP-EHH population.
# Inputs:
#   - output/ihs_result/high_ihs_all_categories.tsv
#   - output/ihs_result/high_xpehh_all_categories.tsv
# Output:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - The input files are already high-signal SNP sets generated upstream.
#   - n_datasets counts support from iHS and/or XP-EHH; 2 means both tools support
#     the same SNP for the same focal CRT group.
#   - PX1 is relabelled when PF3D7_0720700 appears in significant SNP annotations.
################################################################################
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
OUT_FILE <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_snp/hrp_deletion_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv"
cat("Loading iHS data...\n")
ihs <- read.delim("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/ihs_result/high_ihs_all_categories.tsv")
cat("  iHS SNPs:", nrow(ihs), "\n\n")


cat("Loading XP-EHH data...\n")
xpehh <- read.delim("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/ihs_result/high_xpehh_all_categories.tsv")
cat("  XP-EHH SNPs:", nrow(xpehh), "\n\n")

IHS <- ihs %>% dplyr::select(CHR, POSITION, IHS, LOGPVALUE, Gene_name, category_name)
colnames(IHS) <- c("Chr", "Position", "IHS", "iHS_logp", "iHS_Gene", "iHS_Region")
setDT(IHS)
IHS <- unique(IHS)
cat("  iHS unique SNPs after dedup:", nrow(IHS), "\n")

XP <- xpehh %>% dplyr::select(CHR, POSITION, XPEHH, LOGPVALUE, Gene_name, category_name)
colnames(XP) <- c("Chr", "Position", "XPEHH", "XPEHH_logp", "XPEHH_Gene", "XPEHH_Comparison")
setDT(XP)
XP[, c("XPEHH_pop1", "XPEHH_pop2") := tstrsplit(XPEHH_Comparison, "|", fixed = TRUE)]
XP[, XPEHH_pop1 := trimws(XPEHH_pop1)]
XP[, XPEHH_pop2 := trimws(XPEHH_pop2)]
XP <- unique(XP)
cat("  XP-EHH unique SNPs after dedup:", nrow(XP), "\n")

cat("  Done.\n\n")



# PART 4: MERGE PER CHROMOSOME
# ==============================================================================

cat("Merging datasets...\n\n")

all_chrs <- sort(unique(c(IHS$Chr, XP$Chr)))
all_chrs <- all_chrs[!is.na(all_chrs)]

results_list <- list()

for (chr in all_chrs) {
  cat("  Chr", chr, "...\n")

  ihs_chr <- IHS[Chr == chr]
  xp_chr  <- XP[Chr == chr]

  ihs_chr[, .ihs_id := .I]
  xp_chr[,  .xp_id  := .I]

  cat("    iHS:", nrow(ihs_chr), "| XP-EHH:", nrow(xp_chr), "\n")

  result <- data.table()

  if (nrow(ihs_chr) > 0 && nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    ov_xp <- merge(ihs_chr, xp_chr, by = c("Chr", "Position"),
                   all = FALSE, allow.cartesian = TRUE)

    ov_xp <- ov_xp[
      !is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region == XPEHH_pop1
    ]

    ihs_matched <- unique(ov_xp$.ihs_id)
    xp_matched  <- unique(ov_xp$.xp_id)

    ihs_only <- ihs_chr[!.ihs_id %in% ihs_matched]
    xp_only  <- xp_chr[!.xp_id  %in% xp_matched]

    result <- rbind(ov_xp, ihs_only, fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(xp_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, xp_only, fill = TRUE)

  } else if (nrow(ihs_chr) > 0) {
    result <- ihs_chr
  } else if (nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    result <- xp_chr
  }

  cat("    After iHS+XP-EHH:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  temp_cols <- grep("^\\.", names(result), value = TRUE)
  if (length(temp_cols) > 0) result[, (temp_cols) := NULL]

  results_list[[as.character(chr)]] <- result

  rm(ihs_chr, xp_chr, result)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}


# PART 5: COMBINE AND FINALIZE
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCombining all chromosomes...\n")
result <- rbindlist(results_list, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
setorder(result, Chr, Position, na.last = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# PART 6: SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("INTEGRATION COMPLETE\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Final dataset: 'result'\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(result), "\n")
cat("  Chromosomes:", paste(sort(unique(result$Chr)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

result[, n_datasets := (!is.na(iHS_Region)) + (!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison))]

cat("Dataset overlap distribution:\n")
print(table(result$n_datasets))
cat("\n")

result[, combo := paste(
  ifelse(!is.na(iHS_Region),       "iHS", ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison), "XP",  ""),
  sep = "+"
)]
result[, combo := gsub("\\+{2,}", "+", combo)]
result[, combo := gsub("^\\+|\\+$", "", combo)]

cat("Dataset combinations (top 10):\n")
print(head(sort(table(result$combo), decreasing = TRUE), 10))

cat("\nFirst 20 rows:\n")
print(head(result, 20))

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Result stored in 'result' data.table\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")

# ==============================================================================
# ANNOTATION CHECK
# ==============================================================================

gene_cols <- grep("_Gene$", names(result), value = TRUE)
gene_strings <- unlist(result[, ..gene_cols])
gene_strings <- gene_strings[!is.na(gene_strings) & gene_strings != ""]

px1_hits <- grep("PF3D7_0720700", gene_strings, value = TRUE)
if (length(px1_hits) > 0) {
  for (col in gene_cols) {
    result[get(col) == "PF3D7_0720700", (col) := "PX1"]
  }
  cat("CHECK PASSED: PF3D7_0720700 found and relabelled as PX1 in", length(px1_hits), "row(s)\n")
} else {
  cat("CHECK NOTE: PF3D7_0720700 not present in this result (gene may not be in a significant SNP)\n")
}

# setwd(BASE_DIR)
fwrite(result, OUT_FILE, sep = "\t")
cat("Saved:", OUT_FILE, "\n")
```

## Plot HRP deletion SNP-level selection signals

This chunk creates Manhattan and iHS-versus-XP-EHH scatter plots from the integrated HRP deletion SNP results, separately for each HRP deletion category.

```{r plot-hrp-snp-signals, eval=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: hide
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
################################################################################
# CHUNK 10: PLOT SNP-LEVEL CRT SELECTION SIGNALS
# Purpose:
#   Makes per-group SNP visualisations from the integrated iHS/XP-EHH table:
#   1. Two-panel Manhattan plot with iHS on top and XP-EHH below.
#   2. Scatter plot comparing iHS -log10(p) and XP-EHH -log10(p) for SNPs found
#      by both tools.
# Inputs:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv
# Outputs:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/snp_plots_crt_*_manhattan.pdf
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/snp_plots_crt_*_scatter.pdf
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - IHS_THRESH = -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.0))), equivalent to |iHS| >= 2.0.
#   - XPEHH_THRESH = -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.5))), equivalent to |XP-EHH| >= 2.5.
#   - TOP_N_GENES = 20 limits the maximum labelled genes per plot.
#   - Manhattan foreground points are restricted to SNPs detected by both tools.
################################################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IN_FILE        <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_snp/hrp_deletion_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv"
OUT_PREFIX     <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_snp/snp_plots_hrp_deletion"
ANALYSIS_LABEL <- "hrp deletion vs WT"
IHS_THRESH     <- -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.0)))   # |iHS| >= 2.0 on logp scale
XPEHH_THRESH   <- -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.5)))   # |XP-EHH| >= 2.5 on logp scale
TOP_N_GENES    <- 20

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "wild" = "#D62728",
  "hrp2_hrp3_deleted"  = "#4E79A7",
  "hrp3_only_deleted" = "#F28E2B",
)

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "wild" = "wild",
  "hrp2_hrp3_deleted"  = "hrp2_hrp3_deleted",
  "hrp3_only_deleted" = "hrp3_only_deleted"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading:", IN_FILE, "\n")
snps <- read.delim(IN_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Chr        = as.integer(Chr),
    Position   = as.numeric(Position),
    iHS_logp   = as.numeric(iHS_logp),
    XPEHH_logp = as.numeric(XPEHH_logp),
    n_datasets = as.integer(n_datasets)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chr), !is.na(Position))

cat("  Total SNP rows:", nrow(snps), "\n")
cat("  Detected by both tools:", sum(snps$n_datasets == 2, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. CHROMOSOME OFFSETS
# ==============================================================================

chr_lengths <- data.frame(
  Chr    = 1:14,
  length = c(643292, 947102, 1067971, 1200490, 1343557, 1418242, 1445207,
             1472805, 1541735, 1687656, 2038340, 2271494, 2925236, 3291936)
)

chr_offsets <- chr_lengths %>%
  arrange(Chr) %>%
  mutate(offset = cumsum(lag(length, default = 0)) + (Chr - 1) * 2e5)

chr_midpoints <- chr_offsets %>% mutate(mid = offset + length / 2)

snps <- snps %>%
  left_join(chr_offsets %>% select(Chr, offset), by = "Chr") %>%
  mutate(
    pos_cum = Position + offset,
    detection = case_when(
      n_datasets == 2                         ~ "Both tools",
      !is.na(iHS_logp)  & is.na(XPEHH_logp)  ~ "iHS only",
      is.na(iHS_logp)   & !is.na(XPEHH_logp) ~ "XP-EHH only",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Both tools"
    )
  )

det_colors <- c("Both tools" = "#D62728", "iHS only" = "#AEC7E8", "XP-EHH only" = "#FFBB78")
det_sizes  <- c("Both tools" = 1.2,       "iHS only" = 0.6,       "XP-EHH only" = 0.6)
det_alpha  <- c("Both tools" = 1.0,       "iHS only" = 0.5,       "XP-EHH only" = 0.5)

x_breaks <- chr_midpoints$mid
x_labs   <- as.character(chr_midpoints$Chr)
x_lim    <- range(snps$pos_cum, na.rm = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 3 & 4. PLOTS PER GROUP
# ==============================================================================

GROUP_COL <- "iHS_Region"

groups_in_data <- intersect(names(GROUP_COLORS), unique(snps[[GROUP_COL]]))
cat("Groups found in data:", paste(groups_in_data, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

for (grp in groups_in_data) {

  grp_label    <- ifelse(grp %in% names(GROUP_LABELS), GROUP_LABELS[[grp]], grp)
  cat("==============================\n")
  cat("Processing:", grp_label, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")

  snps_c       <- filter(snps, .data[[GROUP_COL]] == grp)
  out_prefix_c <- paste0(OUT_PREFIX, "_", grp)

  if (nrow(snps_c) == 0) {
    cat("  No SNPs for", grp_label, "— skipping.\n\n")
    next
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1 — TWO-PANEL MANHATTAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cat("  Generating Manhattan plot...\n")

  ihs_pts <- snps_c %>%
    filter(!is.na(iHS_logp)) %>%
    group_by(Chr, Position, pos_cum, iHS_Region, iHS_Gene, detection) %>%
    summarise(iHS_logp = max(iHS_logp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  xp_pts <- snps_c %>%
    filter(!is.na(XPEHH_logp)) %>%
    group_by(Chr, Position, pos_cum, XPEHH_Comparison, XPEHH_Gene, detection) %>%
    summarise(XPEHH_logp = max(XPEHH_logp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ihs_fg <- ihs_pts %>% filter(iHS_logp   >= IHS_THRESH,   detection == "Both tools")
  xp_fg  <- xp_pts  %>% filter(XPEHH_logp >= XPEHH_THRESH, detection == "Both tools")

  ihs_labels <- ihs_fg %>%
    filter(!is.na(iHS_Gene) & iHS_Gene != "" & iHS_Gene != "NA") %>%
    group_by(iHS_Gene) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    slice_max(iHS_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    slice_max(iHS_logp, n = TOP_N_GENES, with_ties = FALSE)

  xp_labels <- xp_fg %>%
    filter(!is.na(XPEHH_Gene) & XPEHH_Gene != "" & XPEHH_Gene != "NA") %>%
    group_by(XPEHH_Gene) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    slice_max(XPEHH_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    slice_max(XPEHH_logp, n = TOP_N_GENES, with_ties = FALSE)

  p_ihs <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = pos_cum, y = iHS_logp)) +
    geom_point(data = ihs_fg, colour = "#D62728", size = 2.0, stroke = 0) +
    geom_text_repel(data = ihs_labels, aes(label = iHS_Gene), size = 2.5, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = IHS_THRESH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs, limits = x_lim,
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](p)~"(iHS)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

  p_xp <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = pos_cum, y = XPEHH_logp)) +
    geom_point(data = xp_fg, colour = "#D62728", size = 2.0, stroke = 0) +
    geom_text_repel(data = xp_labels, aes(label = XPEHH_Gene), size = 2.5, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42,
                    direction = "y") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = XPEHH_THRESH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs, limits = x_lim,
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    labs(x = "Chromosome", y = expression(-log[10](p)~"(XP-EHH)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

  p_manhattan <- plot_grid(p_ihs, p_xp, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1), align = "v")
  ggsave(paste0(out_prefix_c, "_manhattan.pdf"), plot = p_manhattan, width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", out_prefix_c, "_manhattan.pdf")
  print(p_manhattan)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 2 — iHS vs XP-EHH SCATTER (co-detected SNPs)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cat("  Generating scatter plot...\n")

  scatter_df <- snps_c %>%
    filter(n_datasets == 2, !is.na(iHS_logp), !is.na(XPEHH_logp)) %>%
    group_by(Chr, Position, iHS_Region) %>%
    slice_max(XPEHH_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(gene_label = case_when(
      !is.na(iHS_Gene)   & iHS_Gene   != "" & iHS_Gene   != "NA" ~ iHS_Gene,
      !is.na(XPEHH_Gene) & XPEHH_Gene != "" & XPEHH_Gene != "NA" ~ XPEHH_Gene,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))

  cat("  Co-detected SNPs:", nrow(scatter_df), "\n")

  if (nrow(scatter_df) == 0) {
    cat("  No co-detected SNPs — skipping scatter.\n\n")
    next
  }

  sig_labels <- scatter_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_label),
           iHS_logp >= IHS_THRESH, XPEHH_logp >= XPEHH_THRESH) %>%
    group_by(gene_label) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    slice_max(iHS_logp + XPEHH_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  p_scatter <- ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = iHS_logp, y = XPEHH_logp)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, colour = GROUP_COLORS[grp]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = IHS_THRESH,   linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = XPEHH_THRESH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sig_labels, aes(label = gene_label), size = 2.5, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey60",
                    segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    labs(x = expression(-log[10](p)~"(iHS)"), y = expression(-log[10](p)~"(XP-EHH)"),
         title    = paste0("Co-detected SNPs — ", grp_label),
         subtitle = paste0(nrow(scatter_df), " SNPs detected by both iHS and XP-EHH")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

  ggsave(paste0(out_prefix_c, "_scatter.pdf"), plot = p_scatter, width = 8, height = 7, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", out_prefix_c, "_scatter.pdf")
  print(p_scatter)

  cat("\n")
}

cat("Done.\n")

```

## Integrate HRP deletion window-level selection signals

This chunk combines overlapping HRP deletion windows from Tajima's D, iHS, XP-EHH, and hmmIBD. It applies the same group-specific percentile thresholds as the K13 analysis and writes an integrated, gene-annotated results table.

```{r integrate-hrp-window-signals, eval=FALSE}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 11: INTEGRATE WINDOW-LEVEL SELECTION SIGNALS
# Purpose:
#   Combines window-level evidence from Tajima's D, iHS, XP-EHH, and hmmIBD for
#   the CRT groups. Windows are merged by physical overlap within chromosome and
#   retained as matching evidence only when they refer to the same CRT group.
# Inputs:
#   - output/tajimasD_all_annotated_q0.1_merged.tsv
#   - output/ihs_result/cr_ihs_all_categories_annot.tsv
#   - output/ihs_result/cr_xpehh_all_categories_annot.tsv
#   - output/hmmibd_result/crt/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv
# Output:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_window/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_windows.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - Tajima's D keeps extreme negative windows: bottom 15% per CRT group.
#   - IBD keeps high-sharing windows: top 15% per CRT group, using fraction >=
#     the 85th percentile.
#   - q0.1 Tajima annotated input is used from annotate.R as a prefiltered set.
#   - n_datasets counts support from TD, iHS, IBD, and XP-EHH.
# Important PX1 annotation note:
#   - PF3D7_0720700(PX1) may not appear in the original hmmIBD annotated file.
#   - If a final merged window overlaps the known PX1 coordinates
#     chr7:889883-899213, this script manually adds PF3D7_0720700(PX1) to the
#     gene/product columns.
#   - Therefore, a final row with combo == "IBD" and IBD_genes containing PX1
#     means the high-IBD window overlaps the PX1 locus by coordinates; it does
#     not necessarily mean PX1 was present in the original hmmIBD annotation.
################################################################################

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

# TD/IBD group names → EHH group names
# GROUP_RECODE <- c("Gambella" = "cviet_mut", "other" = "cvmnnk_wt")
# GROUPS_EHH   <- c("cviet_mut", "cvmnnk_wt")   # names used in EHH files
# GROUPS_TD_IBD <- names(GROUP_RECODE)           # names used in TD/IBD files

EHH_DIR  <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/ihs_result"
OUT_FILE <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_window/hrp_deletion_selection_analysis_windows.tsv"

# ==============================================================================
# PART 1: LOAD AND PREPARE TAJIMA'S D DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading Tajima's D data...\n")

tajima_d <- read.csv("output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/tajimasD_all_annotated_q0.1_merged.tsv", sep = "\t")
tajima_d <- tajima_d %>% filter(!chr %in% c("Pf_M76611", "Pf3D7_API_v3"))

# tajima_d$group is already in the EHH naming convention (cvmnnk_wt/cviet_mut); no recode needed
# tajima_d <- tajima_d %>% filter(group %in% GROUPS_EHH)

percentiles <- tajima_d %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(p_low  = quantile(TajimaD, 0.15, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_high = quantile(TajimaD, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

tajima_d2        <- tajima_d %>% left_join(percentiles, by = "group")
extremes_df_groups <- tajima_d2 %>% filter(!is.na(TajimaD) & TajimaD <= p_low)

cat("  Extreme negative Tajima's D windows:", nrow(extremes_df_groups), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 2: LOAD SELECTION DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading EHH data...\n")
cr_ihs   <- read.delim(file.path(EHH_DIR, "cr_ihs_all_categories_annot.tsv"))
cr_xpehh <- read.delim(file.path(EHH_DIR, "cr_xpehh_all_categories_annot.tsv"))
cat("  iHS windows:    ", nrow(cr_ihs), "\n")
cat("  XP-EHH windows:", nrow(cr_xpehh), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 3: LOAD IBD DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading IBD data...\n")
ibd <- read.delim("output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/hmmibd_result/hrp_status/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv")
# ibd <- ibd[ibd$category %in% GROUPS_EHH, ]

# Recode IBD categories to EHH naming convention
# ibd$category <- dplyr::recode(ibd$category, !!!GROUP_RECODE)

percentiles_ibd <- ibd %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(p_low  = quantile(fraction, 0.15, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_high = quantile(fraction, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

ibd <- ibd %>%
  left_join(percentiles_ibd, by = "category") %>%
  filter(!is.na(fraction), fraction >= p_high)

cat("  High IBD windows:", nrow(ibd), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 4: STANDARDIZE FORMATS
# ==============================================================================

cat("Standardizing formats...\n")

TD <- extremes_df_groups %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, N_SNPS, TajimaD, genes, products, group)
colnames(TD) <- c("Chr", "TD_start", "TD_end", "TD_SNP_n", "TD",
                  "TD_genes", "TD_products", "TD_Region")
TD$Chr <- gsub("Pf3D7_0|Pf3D7_|_v3", "", TD$Chr)
TD$Chr <- as.numeric(as.character(TD$Chr))

cr_ihs <- cr_ihs %>% dplyr::select(chr, start, end, category_name, genes, products)
colnames(cr_ihs) <- c("Chr", "iHS_start", "iHS_end", "iHS_Region", "iHS_genes", "iHS_products")

ibd <- ibd %>% dplyr::select(chr, start, end, fraction, category, gene_name, gene_product)
colnames(ibd) <- c("Chr", "IBD_start", "IBD_end", "IBD_fraction", "IBD_Region",
                   "IBD_genes", "IBD_products")

cr_xpehh <- cr_xpehh %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, category_name, PERC_EXTR_MRK, genes, products)
colnames(cr_xpehh) <- c("Chr", "XPEHH_start", "XPEHH_end", "XPEHH_Comparison",
                        "XPEHH_extra_marks_p", "XPEHH_genes", "XPEHH_products")

setDT(TD); setDT(cr_ihs); setDT(ibd); setDT(cr_xpehh)
TD <- unique(TD); cr_ihs <- unique(cr_ihs)
ibd <- unique(ibd); cr_xpehh <- unique(cr_xpehh)

cat("  Done.\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 5: SPLIT XP-EHH INTO TWO POPULATIONS
# ==============================================================================

cat("Splitting XP-EHH comparisons into population pairs...\n")
cr_xpehh[, c("XPEHH_pop1", "XPEHH_pop2") := tstrsplit(XPEHH_Comparison, "|", fixed = TRUE)]
cr_xpehh[, XPEHH_pop1 := trimws(XPEHH_pop1)]
cr_xpehh[, XPEHH_pop2 := trimws(XPEHH_pop2)]
cat("  Split", nrow(cr_xpehh), "XP-EHH regions into pop1 and pop2\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 6: MERGE STEP-BY-STEP PER CHROMOSOME
# ==============================================================================

cat("Merging datasets...\n\n")

all_chrs <- sort(unique(c(TD$Chr, cr_ihs$Chr, ibd$Chr, cr_xpehh$Chr)))
all_chrs <- all_chrs[!is.na(all_chrs)]

results_list <- list()

for (chr in all_chrs) {
  cat("  Chr", chr, "...\n")

  TD_chr  <- TD[Chr == chr]
  ihs_chr <- cr_ihs[Chr == chr]
  ibd_chr <- ibd[Chr == chr]
  xp_chr  <- cr_xpehh[Chr == chr]

  TD_chr[,  .td_id  := .I]
  ihs_chr[, .ihs_id := .I]
  ibd_chr[, .ibd_id := .I]
  xp_chr[,  .xp_id  := .I]

  cat("    TD:", nrow(TD_chr), "| iHS:", nrow(ihs_chr),
      "| IBD:", nrow(ibd_chr), "| XP-EHH:", nrow(xp_chr), "\n")

  # === STEP 1: TD + iHS ===
  result      <- data.table()
  td_matched  <- integer(0)
  ihs_matched <- integer(0)

  if (nrow(TD_chr) > 0 && nrow(ihs_chr) > 0) {
    setkeyv(TD_chr,  c("Chr", "TD_start",  "TD_end"))
    setkeyv(ihs_chr, c("Chr", "iHS_start", "iHS_end"))

    ov <- foverlaps(TD_chr, ihs_chr, type = "any", nomatch = NULL)
    ov <- ov[TD_start < iHS_end & iHS_start < TD_end]
    ov <- ov[TD_Region == iHS_Region]

    if (nrow(ov) > 0) {
      result      <- rbind(result, ov, fill = TRUE)
      td_matched  <- ov$.td_id
      ihs_matched <- ov$.ihs_id
    }
  }

  if (nrow(TD_chr)  > 0) {
    td_only <- TD_chr[!.td_id %in% td_matched]
    if (nrow(td_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, td_only, fill = TRUE)
  }
  if (nrow(ihs_chr) > 0) {
    ihs_only <- ihs_chr[!.ihs_id %in% ihs_matched]
    if (nrow(ihs_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, ihs_only, fill = TRUE)
  }

  cat("    After TD+iHS:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  # === STEP 2: + IBD ===
  if (nrow(result) > 0 && nrow(ibd_chr) > 0) {
    start_cols2 <- intersect(c("TD_start", "iHS_start"), names(result))
    end_cols2   <- intersect(c("TD_end",   "iHS_end"),   names(result))
    result[, unified_start := do.call(pmin, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = start_cols2]
    result[, unified_end   := do.call(pmax, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = end_cols2]
    result[, .res_id := .I]

    res_valid <- result[!is.na(unified_start) & !is.na(unified_end)]
    res_na    <- result[is.na(unified_start)  | is.na(unified_end)]

    if (nrow(res_valid) > 0) {
      setkeyv(res_valid, c("Chr", "unified_start", "unified_end"))
      setkeyv(ibd_chr,  c("Chr", "IBD_start",     "IBD_end"))

      ov_ibd <- foverlaps(res_valid, ibd_chr, type = "any", nomatch = NULL)
      ov_ibd <- ov_ibd[unified_start < IBD_end & IBD_start < unified_end]
      for (col in c("TD_Region", "iHS_Region")) {
        if (!col %in% names(ov_ibd)) ov_ibd[, (col) := NA_character_]
      }
      ov_ibd <- ov_ibd[
        (!is.na(TD_Region)  & TD_Region  == IBD_Region) |
        (!is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region == IBD_Region)
      ]

      res_matched <- ov_ibd[!is.na(.res_id), unique(.res_id)]
      ibd_matched <- ov_ibd[!is.na(.ibd_id), unique(.ibd_id)]

      if (nrow(ov_ibd) > 0) {
        ov_ibd[, .match_pop := fcoalesce(TD_Region, iHS_Region)]
        first_nonNA <- function(x) { nna <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(nna)) nna[1] else x[NA_integer_] }
        ov_ibd <- ov_ibd[, lapply(.SD, first_nonNA), by = .(.ibd_id, .match_pop)]
        ov_ibd[, .match_pop := NULL]
      }

      res_unmatched <- res_valid[!.res_id %in% res_matched]
      result <- rbind(ov_ibd, res_unmatched, res_na, fill = TRUE)

      ibd_only <- ibd_chr[!.ibd_id %in% ibd_matched]
      if (nrow(ibd_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, ibd_only, fill = TRUE)
    } else {
      result <- rbind(result, ibd_chr, fill = TRUE)
    }
    result[, c("unified_start", "unified_end", ".res_id") := NULL]
  } else if (nrow(ibd_chr) > 0) {
    result <- rbind(result, ibd_chr, fill = TRUE)
  }

  cat("    After +IBD:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  # === STEP 3: + XP-EHH ===
  if (nrow(result) > 0 && nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    start_cols <- intersect(c("TD_start", "iHS_start", "IBD_start"), names(result))
    end_cols   <- intersect(c("TD_end",   "iHS_end",   "IBD_end"),   names(result))

    result[, unified_start := do.call(pmin, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = start_cols]
    result[, unified_end   := do.call(pmax, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = end_cols]
    result[, .res_id := .I]

    res_valid <- result[!is.na(unified_start) & !is.na(unified_end)]
    res_na    <- result[is.na(unified_start)  | is.na(unified_end)]

    if (nrow(res_valid) > 0) {
      setkeyv(res_valid, c("Chr", "unified_start", "unified_end"))
      setkeyv(xp_chr,   c("Chr", "XPEHH_start",   "XPEHH_end"))

      ov_xp <- foverlaps(res_valid, xp_chr, type = "any", nomatch = NULL)
      ov_xp <- ov_xp[unified_start < XPEHH_end & XPEHH_start < unified_end]

      for (col in c("TD_Region", "iHS_Region", "IBD_Region")) {
        if (!col %in% names(ov_xp)) ov_xp[, (col) := NA_character_]
      }

      ov_xp <- ov_xp[
        (!is.na(TD_Region)  & TD_Region  == XPEHH_pop1) |
          (!is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region == XPEHH_pop1) |
          (!is.na(IBD_Region) & IBD_Region == XPEHH_pop1)
      ]

      res_matched <- ov_xp[!is.na(.res_id), unique(.res_id)]
      xp_matched  <- ov_xp[!is.na(.xp_id),  unique(.xp_id)]

      if (nrow(ov_xp) > 0) {
        ov_xp[, .match_pop := fcoalesce(TD_Region, iHS_Region, IBD_Region)]
        first_nonNA <- function(x) { nna <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(nna)) nna[1] else x[NA_integer_] }
        ov_xp <- ov_xp[, lapply(.SD, first_nonNA), by = .(.xp_id, .match_pop)]
        ov_xp[, .match_pop := NULL]
      }

      res_unmatched <- res_valid[!.res_id %in% res_matched]
      result <- rbind(ov_xp, res_unmatched, res_na, fill = TRUE)

      xp_only <- xp_chr[!.xp_id %in% xp_matched]
      if (nrow(xp_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, xp_only, fill = TRUE)
    } else {
      result <- rbind(result, xp_chr, fill = TRUE)
    }
    result[, c("unified_start", "unified_end", ".res_id") := NULL]
  } else if (nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    result <- rbind(result, xp_chr, fill = TRUE)
  }

  cat("    After +XP-EHH:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  temp_cols <- grep("^\\.|^i\\.", names(result), value = TRUE)
  if (length(temp_cols) > 0) result[, (temp_cols) := NULL]

  result <- unique(result)
  cat("    After dedup:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  results_list[[as.character(chr)]] <- result

  rm(TD_chr, ihs_chr, ibd_chr, xp_chr, result)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 7: COMBINE AND FINALIZE
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCombining all chromosomes...\n")
result <- rbindlist(results_list, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
result <- unique(result)
cat("  Rows after global dedup:", nrow(result), "\n")

result[, `:=`(
  combined_start = pmin(TD_start, iHS_start, IBD_start, XPEHH_start, na.rm = TRUE),
  combined_end   = pmax(TD_end,   iHS_end,   IBD_end,   XPEHH_end,   na.rm = TRUE)
)]

setorder(result, Chr, combined_start, na.last = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# PART 8: SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("INTEGRATION COMPLETE\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Final dataset: 'result'\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(result), "\n")
cat("  Chromosomes:", paste(sort(unique(result$Chr)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

result[, n_datasets := (!is.na(TD_Region)) + (!is.na(iHS_Region)) +
         (!is.na(IBD_Region)) + (!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison))]

cat("Dataset overlap distribution:\n")
print(table(result$n_datasets))
cat("\n")

result[, combo := paste(
  ifelse(!is.na(TD_Region),        "TD",  ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(iHS_Region),       "iHS", ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(IBD_Region),       "IBD", ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison), "XP",  ""),
  sep = "+"
)]
result[, combo := gsub("\\+{2,}", "+", combo)]
result[, combo := gsub("^\\+|\\+$", "", combo)]

cat("Dataset combinations (top 10):\n")
print(head(sort(table(result$combo), decreasing = TRUE), 10))

cat("\nFirst 20 rows:\n")
print(head(result, 20))

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Result stored in 'result' data.table\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")

result[!is.na(TD_Region), .(N = .N,
                             min_TD  = min(TD,  na.rm = TRUE),
                             max_TD  = max(TD,  na.rm = TRUE),
                             mean_TD = mean(TD, na.rm = TRUE)),
       by = TD_Region][order(TD_Region)]

# ==============================================================================
# ANNOTATION CHECK
# ==============================================================================

gene_cols <- grep("_genes$", names(result), value = TRUE)
gene_strings <- unlist(result[, ..gene_cols])
gene_strings <- gene_strings[!is.na(gene_strings) & gene_strings != ""]

px1_hits <- grep("PF3D7_0720700", gene_strings, value = TRUE)
if (length(px1_hits) > 0) {
  for (col in gene_cols) {
    result[grepl("PF3D7_0720700", get(col)),
           (col) := gsub("PF3D7_0720700\\([^)]*\\)", "PF3D7_0720700(PX1)", get(col))]
  }
  cat("CHECK PASSED: PF3D7_0720700 found and relabelled as PX1 in", length(px1_hits), "instance(s)\n")
} else {
  # Manually annotate windows overlapping PX1 gene (Pf3D7_07_v3:889883..899213)
  px1_chr <- 7
  px1_start <- 889883
  px1_end   <- 899213
  px1_gene  <- "PF3D7_0720700(PX1)"
  px1_prod  <- "phosphoinositide-binding protein"

  px1_rows <- result[Chr == px1_chr & combined_start < px1_end & combined_end > px1_start]

  if (nrow(px1_rows) > 0) {
    prod_cols <- grep("_products$", names(result), value = TRUE)
    idx <- result[, which(Chr == px1_chr & combined_start < px1_end & combined_end > px1_start)]

    for (i in seq_along(gene_cols)) {
      gcol <- gene_cols[i]
      pcol <- prod_cols[i]
      for (r in idx) {
        cur_gene <- result[[gcol]][r]
        if (is.na(cur_gene) || cur_gene == "") {
          set(result, r, gcol, px1_gene)
          set(result, r, pcol, px1_prod)
        } else if (!grepl("PF3D7_0720700", cur_gene)) {
          set(result, r, gcol, paste0(cur_gene, ",", px1_gene))
          set(result, r, pcol, paste0(result[[pcol]][r], ",", px1_prod))
        }
      }
    }
    cat("CHECK PASSED: PX1 manually annotated in", length(idx), "overlapping window(s)\n")
  } else {
    cat("CHECK NOTE: No windows on chr 7 overlap PX1 coordinates (889883-899213)\n")
  }
}

setwd(BASE_DIR)
fwrite(result, OUT_FILE, sep = "\t")
cat("Saved:", OUT_FILE, "\n")
```

## Plot HRP deletion window-level selection karyograms

This chunk generates chromosome karyograms from the integrated HRP deletion windows. The plots summarize genomic regions supported by multiple selection methods and label associated genes.

```{r plot-hrp-window-karyogram, eval=TRUE}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
################################################################################
# CHUNK 12: PLOT WINDOW-LEVEL SELECTION KARYOGRAMS
# Purpose:
#   Draws chromosome-level maps of integrated selection windows. One figure shows
#   all CRT groups together, and one figure is produced for each CRT group.
# Inputs:
#   - output_Gambella_vs_other/comp_selection_signals_window/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_windows.tsv
# Outputs:
#   - output_Gambella_vs_other/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_group_all.pdf
#   - output_Gambella_vs_other/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_<group>.pdf
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - All-group plot keeps windows detected by at least 2 tools.
#   - Gene labels on the all-group plot require at least 3 supporting tools.
#   - Per-group plots keep windows detected by at least 2 tools.
#   - CEN_ZONE=40000 defines the centromere constriction zone around each
#     chromosome centromere position for plotting only.
################################################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggforce)
library(ggrepel)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IN_FILE      <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_window/hrp_deletion_selection_analysis_windows.tsv"
CHR_SPACING  <- 1.6
CHR_W        <- 0.28
CEN_W        <- 0.06
CEN_ZONE     <- 40000
SHAPE_RADIUS <- unit(3, "mm")

# GROUP_LABELS <- c(
#   "Gambella" = "Gambella",
#   "Other"     = "Other"
# )

# ==============================================================================
# 1. CHROMOSOME REFERENCE DATA
# ==============================================================================

chr_lengths <- data.frame(
  Chr    = 1:14,
  length = c(643292, 947102, 1067971, 1200490, 1343557, 1418242, 1445207,
             1472805, 1541735, 1687656, 2038340, 2271494, 2925236, 3291936)
) %>% mutate(x_pos = Chr * CHR_SPACING)

centromeres <- data.frame(
  Chr     = 1:14,
  cen_mid = c(
    (458021 + 462661) / 2, (446771 + 450941) / 2,
    (593691 + 597951) / 2, (648001 + 652321) / 2,
    (454541 + 458791) / 2, (477751 + 482011) / 2,
    (863741 + 868251) / 2, (299011 + 303631) / 2,
    (1241071 + 1245441) / 2, (935681 + 937821) / 2,
    (830781 + 835431) / 2, (1281511 + 1285931) / 2,
    (1167271 + 1171921) / 2, (1070851 + 1075311) / 2
  )
) %>% left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. CHROMOSOME SHAPE
# ==============================================================================

make_chr_vertices <- function(chr_x, chr_len, cen_y,
                               full_w = CHR_W, narrow_w = CEN_W,
                               cen_zone = CEN_ZONE) {
  data.frame(
    group = as.character(chr_x),
    x = c(chr_x - full_w,   chr_x + full_w,
          chr_x + full_w,   chr_x + narrow_w,
          chr_x + full_w,   chr_x + full_w,
          chr_x - full_w,   chr_x - full_w,
          chr_x - narrow_w, chr_x - full_w),
    y = c(0,                0,
          cen_y - cen_zone, cen_y,
          cen_y + cen_zone, chr_len,
          chr_len,          cen_y + cen_zone,
          cen_y,            cen_y - cen_zone)
  )
}

chr_polys <- bind_rows(
  mapply(make_chr_vertices,
         chr_x   = chr_lengths$x_pos,
         chr_len = chr_lengths$length,
         cen_y   = centromeres$cen_mid,
         SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
)

CAP_ZONE_BP <- 55000

chr_half_width_at <- function(chr_val, y_pos) {
  cen_y   <- centromeres$cen_mid[centromeres$Chr == chr_val]
  chr_len <- chr_lengths$length[chr_lengths$Chr == chr_val]
  y_bp <- c(0, CAP_ZONE_BP, cen_y - CEN_ZONE, cen_y, cen_y + CEN_ZONE,
            chr_len - CAP_ZONE_BP, chr_len)
  w_bp <- c(0, CHR_W, CHR_W, CEN_W, CHR_W, CHR_W, 0)
  pmax(0, approx(y_bp, w_bp, xout = y_pos, rule = 2)$y)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. LOAD & PARSE DATA
# ==============================================================================

raw <- read.table(IN_FILE, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
                  fill = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "")

raw_parsed <- raw %>%
  filter(Chr != "Chr") %>%
  mutate(
    Chr            = as.integer(Chr),
    combined_start = as.numeric(combined_start),
    combined_end   = as.numeric(combined_end),
    n_datasets     = as.integer(n_datasets)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chr), !is.na(combined_start), !is.na(n_datasets))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. ALL-GROUPS WINDOWS
# ==============================================================================

windows_all <- raw_parsed %>%
  filter(n_datasets >= 2) %>%
  group_by(Chr, combined_start, combined_end) %>%
  summarise(n_datasets = max(n_datasets), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

# ==============================================================================
# 5. PER-GROUP WINDOWS
# ==============================================================================

extract_group_long <- function(df) {
  ihs <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = iHS_Region, tool = "iHS")
  ibd <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(IBD_Region) & IBD_Region != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = IBD_Region, tool = "IBD")
  td <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(TD_Region) & TD_Region != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = TD_Region, tool = "TD")
  # XPEHH_pop1 is always the selected population (positive XPEHH, focal pop)
  xp <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(XPEHH_pop1) & XPEHH_pop1 != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = XPEHH_pop1, tool = "XP-EHH")
  bind_rows(ihs, ibd, td, xp) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), group != "")
}

group_long <- extract_group_long(raw_parsed)

windows_by_group <- group_long %>%
  group_by(Chr, win_start, win_end, group) %>%
  summarise(n_datasets = n_distinct(tool), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_datasets >= 2) %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

# ==============================================================================
# 6. GENE LABEL EXTRACTION
# ==============================================================================

parse_gene_names <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("_genes"), values_to = "genes") %>%
    filter(!is.na(genes), genes != "", genes != "NA(NA)") %>%
    mutate(gene_name = str_extract_all(genes, "(?<=\\()[^)]+(?=\\))")) %>%
    unnest(gene_name) %>%
    filter(!gene_name %in% c("N/A", "NA", "N", "")) %>%
    mutate(gene_name = recode(gene_name, "PPPK-DHPS" = "DHPS"))
}

extract_gene_labels <- function(windows_df, raw_src,
                                 start_col, end_col, min_tools = 3) {
  sig <- windows_df %>% filter(n_datasets >= min_tools)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(data.frame())
  raw_src %>%
    inner_join(sig, by = setNames(c("Chr", start_col, end_col),
                                   c("Chr", "combined_start", "combined_end"))) %>%
    select(Chr, combined_start, combined_end,
           any_of(c("XPEHH_genes", "IBD_genes", "iHS_genes", "TD_genes"))) %>%
    parse_gene_names() %>%
    group_by(Chr, combined_start, combined_end) %>%
    summarise(label = paste(unique(gene_name), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pos_mid = (combined_start + combined_end) / 2) %>%
    group_by(Chr, pos_mid) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")
}

get_group_gene_labels <- function(grp, windows_g, raw_parsed, min_tools = 2) {
  sig <- windows_g %>% filter(group == grp, n_datasets >= min_tools)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(data.frame())
  raw_parsed %>%
    inner_join(sig, by = c("Chr",
                           "combined_start" = "win_start",
                           "combined_end"   = "win_end")) %>%
    select(Chr, combined_start, combined_end,
           any_of(c("XPEHH_genes", "IBD_genes", "iHS_genes", "TD_genes"))) %>%
    parse_gene_names() %>%
    group_by(Chr, combined_start, combined_end) %>%
    summarise(label = paste(unique(gene_name), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pos_mid = (combined_start + combined_end) / 2) %>%
    group_by(Chr, pos_mid) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")
}

gene_labels_all <- extract_gene_labels(
  windows_all, raw_parsed,
  start_col = "combined_start", end_col = "combined_end", min_tools = 3
)

# ==============================================================================
# 7. COLOR PALETTE & CENTROMERE POINTS
# ==============================================================================

tool_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#801919",
  "2" = "#3288BD",
  "3" = "#F46D43",
  "4" = "#208363"
)
tool_labels <- c("1" = "1 tool", "2" = "2 tools",
                 "3" = "3 tools", "4" = "4 tools (all)")

cen_pts <- centromeres %>% rename(x = x_pos, y = cen_mid)

# ==============================================================================
# 8. PLOT FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================

make_karyogram <- function(windows_df, start_col, end_col,
                            gene_labs, title_str, subtitle_str) {
  win_segs <- windows_df %>%
    mutate(
      win_mid = (.data[[start_col]] + .data[[end_col]]) / 2,
      half_w  = mapply(chr_half_width_at, Chr, win_mid),
      n_fac   = factor(as.character(n_datasets), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      xmin    = x_pos - half_w,
      xmax    = x_pos + half_w,
      ymin    = .data[[start_col]],
      ymax    = .data[[end_col]]
    )

  x_breaks <- chr_lengths$x_pos
  x_labels <- as.character(chr_lengths$Chr)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_shape(data = chr_polys, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
               fill = "white", color = NA, radius = SHAPE_RADIUS) +
    geom_rect(data = win_segs,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                  fill = n_fac),
              color = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_shape(data = chr_polys, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
               fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5,
               radius = SHAPE_RADIUS) +
    geom_point(data = cen_pts, aes(x = x, y = y),
               shape = 16, color = "black", size = 4.5)

  if (!is.null(gene_labs) && nrow(gene_labs) > 0) {
    lab_anchor <- gene_labs %>%
      mutate(x_anchor = x_pos + CHR_W, y_anchor = pos_mid)
    p <- p +
      geom_text_repel(
        data               = lab_anchor,
        aes(x = x_anchor, y = y_anchor, label = label),
        direction          = "y",
        hjust              = 0,
        color              = "black",
        size               = 2.5,
        nudge_x            = 0.08,
        segment.color      = "grey40",
        segment.size       = 0.3,
        segment.linetype   = "solid",
        min.segment.length = 0,
        box.padding        = 0.2,
        point.padding      = 0,
        max.overlaps       = Inf,
        seed               = 42
      )
  }

  p +
    scale_fill_manual(values = tool_colors, labels = tool_labels,
                      name = "Tools detecting window", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels,
                       expand = expansion(add = c(0.8, 2.2))) +
    scale_y_reverse(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x / 1e6, 1), " Mb"),
                    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)) +
    labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Position",
         title = title_str, subtitle = subtitle_str) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      axis.line       = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40")
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 9. ALL-GROUPS FIGURE
# ==============================================================================

p_all <- make_karyogram(
  windows_all,
  start_col    = "combined_start",
  end_col      = "combined_end",
  gene_labs    = gene_labels_all,
  title_str    = "Integrated Selection Signals - cvmnnk_wt vs cviet_mut (Ethiopia)",
  subtitle_str = "Windows detected by >=2 tools | iHS, XP-EHH, Tajima's D, IBD"
)

ggsave("output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_group_all.pdf", plot = p_all,
       width = 20, height = 10, device = "pdf")
message("Saved: karyogram_group_all.pdf")
```

### Create HRP deletion group-specific karyograms

This chunk creates and displays a separate karyogram for each HRP deletion category, retaining windows supported by at least two selection methods.

```{r plot-hrp-group-karyograms, eval=TRUE}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-show: hold
# ==============================================================================
# 10. PER-GROUP FIGURES
# ==============================================================================

groups <- sort(unique(windows_by_group$group))
message("Generating per-group figures for: ", paste(groups, collapse = ", "))

for (grp in groups) {
  win_g <- windows_by_group %>% filter(group == grp)
  glabs <- get_group_gene_labels(grp, windows_by_group, raw_parsed, min_tools = 2)

  grp_label <- ifelse(grp %in% names(GROUP_LABELS), GROUP_LABELS[[grp]], grp)

  p_g <- make_karyogram(
    win_g,
    start_col    = "win_start",
    end_col      = "win_end",
    gene_labs    = glabs,
    title_str    = paste0("Selection Signals - ", grp_label),
    subtitle_str = "Windows detected by >=2 tools | iHS, XP-EHH, Tajima's D, IBD"
  )

  fname <- paste0("output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_", grp)
  ggsave(paste0(fname, ".pdf"), plot = p_g, width = 20, height = 10, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", fname)
  print(p_g)
}
```

## Plot HRP deletion IBD-only windows

This chunk identifies the highest 15% of hmmIBD windows within each HRP deletion group, annotates their genes, and plots them without requiring support from the other selection methods.

```{r plot-hrp-ibd-only-windows, eval=TRUE}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-show: hold
################################################################################
# CHUNK 13: IBD-ONLY WINDOW ANNOTATION AND KARYOGRAM
# Purpose:
#   Annotates and plots high-IBD windows on their own. Unlike CHUNK 11/12, a
#   window is kept here on IBD evidence alone, with no overlap requirement
#   against Tajima's D, iHS, or XP-EHH.
# Inputs:
#   - output_gambella_arbaminch/hmmibd_result/group/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv
# Outputs:
#   - output_gambella_arbaminch/comp_selection_signals_window/gambella_arbaminch_ibd_only_windows.tsv
#   - output_gambella_arbaminch/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_ibd_only_<group>.pdf
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - High IBD windows: fraction >= the 85th percentile within each group.
#   - Gene labels come from the hmmIBD annotation columns only: gene_name when
#     available, otherwise gene_id.
################################################################################
# Requires CHUNK 12 to have been run: reuses make_karyogram(), chr_lengths, chr_polys, cen_pts.

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IBD_FILE       <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/hmmibd_result/hrp_status/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv"
IBD_OUT_TSV    <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_window/hrp_ibd_only_windows.tsv"
IBD_OUT_PREFIX <- "output_k13_hrp/hrp_result/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_ibd_only"
IBD_QUANTILE   <- 0.85

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "wild" = "wild",
  "hrp2_hrp3_deleted"  = "hrp2_hrp3_deleted",
  "hrp3_only_deleted" = "hrp3_only_deleted"
)
# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD AND FILTER HIGH-IBD WINDOWS
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading IBD data:", IBD_FILE, "\n")
ibd_raw <- read.delim(IBD_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("  Total IBD windows:", nrow(ibd_raw), "\n")

ibd_only <- ibd_raw %>%
  filter(!chr %in% c("Pf_M76611", "Pf3D7_API_v3"), !is.na(fraction)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(p_high = quantile(fraction, IBD_QUANTILE, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(fraction >= p_high) %>%
  transmute(
    Chr          = suppressWarnings(as.integer(gsub("Pf3D7_0|Pf3D7_|_v3", "", chr))),
    win_start    = as.numeric(start),
    win_end      = as.numeric(end),
    group        = category,
    IBD_fraction = fraction,
    IBD_gene_id  = gene_id,
    IBD_genes    = gene_name,
    IBD_products = gene_product
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chr), !is.na(win_start), !is.na(win_end))

cat("  High IBD windows (>= q", IBD_QUANTILE, " per group):", nrow(ibd_only), "\n", sep = "")
print(table(ibd_only$group))

dir.create(dirname(IBD_OUT_TSV), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fwrite(ibd_only, IBD_OUT_TSV, sep = "\t")
cat("Saved:", IBD_OUT_TSV, "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. GENE LABELS FROM IBD ANNOTATION ONLY
# ==============================================================================

# hmmIBD stores plain gene names, so the parenthesised parser used for EHH/TD is not applied here.
IBD_NA_LABELS <- c("N/A", "NA", "")

ibd_gene_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(IBD_genes), !IBD_genes %in% IBD_NA_LABELS) %>%
    group_by(Chr, win_start, win_end) %>%
    summarise(label = paste(unique(IBD_genes), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pos_mid = (win_start + win_end) / 2) %>%
    group_by(Chr, pos_mid) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. PER-GROUP IBD-ONLY KARYOGRAMS
# ==============================================================================

windows_ibd <- ibd_only %>%
  mutate(n_datasets = 1L) %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

groups_ibd <- sort(unique(windows_ibd$group))
message("Generating IBD-only figures for: ", paste(groups_ibd, collapse = ", "))

for (grp in groups_ibd) {
  win_g <- windows_ibd %>% filter(group == grp)
  glabs <- ibd_gene_labels(ibd_only %>% filter(group == grp))

  grp_label <- ifelse(grp %in% names(GROUP_LABELS), GROUP_LABELS[[grp]], grp)

  p_g <- make_karyogram(
    win_g,
    start_col    = "win_start",
    end_col      = "win_end",
    gene_labs    = glabs,
    title_str    = paste0("High-IBD Windows - ", grp_label),
    subtitle_str = paste0("hmmIBD only | fraction >= q", IBD_QUANTILE, " within group")
  )

  fname <- paste0(IBD_OUT_PREFIX, "_", grp)
  ggsave(paste0(fname, ".pdf"), plot = p_g, width = 20, height = 10, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", fname, ".pdf")
  print(p_g)
}

cat("Done.\n")
```
